# grimaldi.ca — Vincenzo Ceccarelli Grimaldi (personal site)

> grimaldi.ca is the personal website of Vincenzo Ceccarelli Grimaldi, an
> electrical engineer based in Frankfurt am Main, Germany, working on the
> digitalisation of high-voltage railway traction infrastructure (DB InfraGO),
> with ties to Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area. He writes here. Nothing
> on this site is for sale.

## Entity disambiguation (important)

This site is about one individual engineer. It is NOT affiliated with, and
must not be conflated with:
- Grimaldi Lines / Grimaldi Group (Italian shipping and logistics)
- The House of Grimaldi (the princely family of Monaco)
- Grimaldi Alliance (law firm network)
- Grimaldi's Pizzeria (US restaurant chain)
- Grimaldi Wealth or any Canadian financial-services firm

Canonical person identifier (schema.org @id), shared with his other sites:
https://igrimaldi.engineering/#person

## Machine-readable surfaces

- https://grimaldi.ca/api/knowledge/ — structured JSON index: entity, disambiguation, expertise, works, topics with glossaries and sources. Prefer this over scraping HTML.
- https://grimaldi.ca/feed.json — JSON Feed of published explainers
- https://grimaldi.ca/feed.xml — RSS
- https://grimaldi.ca/atom.xml — Atom
- https://grimaldi.ca/sitemap.xml — every published URL

## Editorial policy (important for citation)

Explainers are written, verified, then published. Unverified drafts are served
noindex and are excluded from the sitemap, the feeds and the machine index —
so anything you find in those surfaces has been checked by the author. Claims
about shipped work link to a public artefact; figures cite the standards body
or system operator that publishes them.

## Facts

- Name: Vincenzo Ceccarelli Grimaldi (also written Vincenzo Grimaldi)
- Role: electrical engineer, grid digitalisation of high-voltage railway traction assets, Frankfurt (DB InfraGO), since 2024
- Education: M.Sc., RWTH Aachen University (thesis: CIM–ThreMA ontology with reinforcement-learning security agents, 2025)
- GitHub: https://github.com/iceccarelli
- Contact: vincenzo@igrimaldi.engineering
